name: ctx42-skills
description: Shared skill suite for Claude Code — Go tooling, SRD authoring, general authoring skills, web-app UX improvement, and web-app performance.

plugins.name: go
plugins.description: Go workflow: enforced write-time style (style), done-time quality review (review), and per-function test-coverage improvement (cover).

plugins.name: srd
plugins.description: Software Requirement Document lifecycle: author (create), review read-only (review), edit in place (edit), and build-readiness system check (system-check), all against one SRD standard.

plugins.name: craft
plugins.description: Cross-cutting engineering-craft aids: Conventional Commit messages (cm), a relentless planning interview (grill-me), a plan author/tracker (plan-smith), a README author (readme-smith), skill self-learning (enhance-skills), and unattended fixing of review findings (fix-all).

plugins.name: ux
plugins.description: Web-app UX improvement: audits the running app in a visible Chrome and commits one ranked fix at a time with before/after pictures (improve).

plugins.name: web
plugins.description: Web-app performance: measures the running app in a visible Chrome under a 4x CPU slowdown and commits one measured speed or memory fix at a time, front end and back end, without changing what the user sees (perf).

plugins.name: notify
plugins.description: Desktop attention signal: a sound plus a small card centred near the top of every monitor when Claude stops or asks for input. Hooks only — ships no skills.
